About Korva

A home is the sum of
what you keep close.

Korva began with a simple belief: the things that hold your memories — and the tables your family gathers around — deserve the same care as the moments themselves.

Every frame and every table we make is shaped from carefully chosen materials, finished by hand, and designed to look timeless in a modern home.
